expectations.text: The skill discovers and reads the existing rules file before writing anything
expectations.evidence: Discovery section: found team-standards.md, existing sections enumerated.

expectations.text: It asks which section the rule belongs in (or suggests Code Style)
expectations.evidence: Chose Debugging section with reasoning about thematic match.

expectations.text: The rule text is one clear imperative sentence
expectations.evidence: Do not commit console.log/debug/warn/info calls. Single imperative sentence.

expectations.text: The rule is classified as T1 (console.log has a clear syntactic signature)
expectations.evidence: Classified T1 with regex pattern for console.(log|debug|warn|info).

expectations.text: The enforcement block has a regex pattern matching console.log
The rule is appended to an appropriate section, not dumped at the end
expectations.evidence: Placed in Debugging section alongside existing logger utility rule.

expectations.text: Budget checks run after generating the block
expectations.evidence: Budget check shows 0 T3, all limits clear.
